name: IT WANTS IN [HORROR]
desc:
Late October. Hollow Pine is on lockdown, and you're trapped in a cabin deep in the woods. Something tall has been watching from the treeline all night. Now it wants inside.

Work together to survive until dawn. Close the curtains. Board up the windows. Keep the fire burning and the breaker on. Every open opening is a danger.

It knocks. It stalks the walls. It crawls across the ceiling. If you are caught, you won't make it to morning.
Hide. Stay quiet. Make it to 6:00 AM.

⚙️ Lobby Options:
• No Power Start
• Friends Only

🎮 Controls:
• Run - Shift
• Crouch - C
• Flashlight - F
• Swap Battery - R
• Interact - E
• Lobby Menu - L

📱💻🎮 All Devices Supported

🎧 Headphones strongly recommended
🎙️ Best experienced with Spatial Voice
🖼️ Max graphics recommended

llm.loop: coop group in a cabin barricades windows, keeps fire and power on -> creature tries to get in -> survive until 6 AM
llm.instructions: close curtains, board windows, keep fire and breaker running, hide, stay quiet
unique: home-defense horror where every opening must be managed
troll products that let buyers jumpscare or black out the server
